Feature Bullet 1: The 5555 standard wax/resin ink formulation is for printing high-quality, durable bar codes on Zebra’s coated paper and matte synthetic label stocks at print speeds up to 6 inches per second.
Feature Bullet 2: Gives a crisp, clear image and maintains its high-quality under harsh environmental conditions such as moderate abrasion, excessive moisture, chemical exposure and high temperatures.
Feature Bullet 3: Ideal for applications where labels are repeatedly wand-scanned, subject to abrasion or friction, outdoors, applied to chemical drums, or exposed to water, steam, alkali or acid solutions.
Feature Bullet 5: Available in industrial, mobile, and desktop sizes (including a cartridge for use in the ZD420 printer)
